description_en: Queries the health check status by calling DescribeHealthCheckStatusList
description_zh: 调用DescribeHealthCheckStatusList查询健康检查状态
name: DescribeHealthCheckStatusList

parameters.help_en: The source IP address of the request. You do not need to specify this parameter. The system automatically obtains the value
parameters.help_zh: 请求源IP。无需填写，系统自动获取
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en:
The Listeners array of forwarding rules to query (JSON character string). Each Listener has the following structure:

InstanceId: string type. Required. The instance ID.
Protocol: string type. Required. The protocol type.
FrontendPort: integer type. Required. The frontend port. Valid values: 0 to 65535.
BackendPort: integer type. Optional. The backend port. Valid values: 0 to 65535.
RealServers: JSON array type. Optional. The IP addresses of the origin server.
IsAutoCreate: Boolean type. Optional. Specifies whether automatic creation is enabled. If the value is true, the rule cannot be deleted or modified
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的转发规则Listeners数组（JSON字符串），每个Listener的具体结构描述如下：

InstanceId，String类型，必选，实例ID。
Protocol，String类型，必选，协议类型。
FrontendPort，Integer类型，必选，前端使用的端口，取值范围：0-65535。
BackendPort，Integer类型，可选，后端使用的端口，取值范围：0-65535。
RealServers，Json数组类型，可选，源站IP地址。
IsAutoCreate，Boolean类型，可选，是否自动创建。如果是，则不允许删除和修改
parameters.name: listeners
